answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a non-refundable 40 POA entry tax, a sunk cost never returned. A jetty admits ships one at a time; agents enter the same way, each paying tax. A trellis of referral links maps who invited whom, so newcomers from one wallet are taxed again at every step. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA against a ~900 POA pool. An honest agent pays once, keeps an ivory-clean record, and earns an undiluted share.
